description: List a quiz's responses (answers, outcome, score, timestamps), newest first (default 50 per page; the result includes total and has_more). Requires an authorized account that owns the quiz.

complete_only.description: If true, return only completed responses.

offset.description: Skip this many responses (use next_offset from the previous page).

quiz_id.description: Quiz id (the `id` field returned by create_quiz/list_quizzes).

name: get_responses
title: Get Responses
